questions.question: Do I have a professional duty to tell my client about ADR options before going to court?
questions.expectContains: inform his client of the option of alternative dispute resolution

questions.question: Which kinds of disputes cannot be resolved through ADR?
questions.expectContains: ADR mechanisms are not available in respect of the following matters

questions.question: Can what was said while the parties were negotiating compensation be used as evidence later?
questions.expectContains: statement made or document made in the course of negotiation

questions.question: What three conditions from Madukolu v Nkemdilim must all be present for a court to have jurisdiction?
questions.expectContains: must co-exist for a court to be competent and seised with jurisdiction

questions.question: When does the Supreme Court sit as a full panel of seven justices instead of five?
questions.expectContains: sits as the full court with 7 justices

questions.question: Can a State High Court hear an ordinary dispute between a bank and its customer, or is that only for the Federal High Court?
questions.expectContains: the exclusive jurisdiction of the FHC is relaxed

questions.question: What is the maximum amount a Magistrate Court can handle in Lagos compared with Abuja?
questions.expectContains: monetary jurisdiction is 10,000,000 in Lagos and 7,000,000 in Abuja

questions.question: Who counts as a necessary party to a suit?
questions.expectContains: be joined in an action for the effectual and complete determination

questions.question: My client wants to sue a business but only knows the trading name, not the owner. Can he still sue?
questions.expectContains: he can be sued in the business name simpliciter

questions.question: If a party dies during the case, which claims end with them and cannot continue?
questions.expectContains: Actions which do not survive the parties

questions.question: What does cause of action mean?
questions.expectContains: the facts which when proved will entitle the plaintiff to a remedy

questions.question: How long does a claimant have to bring an action against the NNPC for neglect or default?
questions.expectContains: court action be taken within 12 months of the occurrence

questions.question: Does the pre-action counselling certificate in Abuja have to be sworn on oath like the Lagos Form 01?
questions.expectContains: Form 6 in the FCT Abuja is not made on oath

questions.question: In what situations will a Magistrate Court refuse to issue a summary summons?
questions.expectContains: Summary summons cannot be issued in the following instances

questions.question: How long is a Magistrate Court summons valid and can it be renewed?
questions.expectContains: All summons expires in three (3) months

questions.question: What is the highest claim I can bring in the Lagos Small Claims Court?
questions.expectContains: monetary claim not exceeding N5,000,000, excluding interest and cost

questions.question: Can a writ be signed in the name of the law firm instead of an individual lawyer?
questions.expectContains: Law firm is incompetent to sign originating process

questions.question: When should I use an originating summons instead of a writ of summons?
questions.expectContains: facts are substantially not in dispute or unlikely to be

questions.question: What happens in Lagos if the claimant files a writ without the frontloaded documents?
questions.expectContains: in Lagos, failure to frontload nullifies the action

questions.question: For how long after issue can a Lagos writ of summons be served before it expires?
questions.expectContains: This writ is to be served within 6 calendar months

questions.question: A writ issued in Lagos is to be served in Abuja. What is the minimum time the defendant must be given to respond?
questions.expectContains: not less than thirty days after service of the writ

questions.question: How long does a defendant served with a Lagos writ have to file a memorandum of appearance?
questions.expectContains: within the time stipulated in the originating process

questions.question: What size of money claim qualifies a case for the Lagos fast track?
questions.expectContains: liquidated monetary relief not less than N100,000,000

questions.question: How long does an ex parte order last before it lapses?
questions.expectContains: In Abuja and Lagos, it shall abate after 7 days

questions.question: What is a Mareva injunction used for?
questions.expectContains: restraining a defendant from removing his assets or disposing of them

questions.question: Under the undefended list, by when must the defendant file his notice of intention to defend and affidavit?
questions.expectContains: before 5 days to the day fixed for hearing

questions.question: What must a defendant prove to get a default judgment against him set aside?
questions.expectContains: Defendant must show a good defence to the claim

questions.question: In which cases can a court not enter default judgment?
questions.expectContains: Where claim is for declaratory relief

questions.question: Can I lead evidence at trial on a fact I did not plead?
questions.expectContains: Parties cannot adduce evidence on an issue not raised in their pleadings

questions.question: What happens to a relief that was in the writ but left out of the statement of claim?
questions.expectContains: but not claimed in statement of claim shall be deemed abandoned

questions.question: What does Order 7 Rule 8 of the Abuja rules say about serving a company?
questions.expectContains: delivery at the head office or any other place of business

questions.question: Does S. 308 immunity cover an election petition against a sitting governor?
questions.expectContains: immunity does not apply to election petition against a sitting governor

questions.question: What is Form 4A in the Lagos Magistrate Court?
questions.expectContains: Form of Admission, Defence and Counter Claim

questions.question: Order 6 Rule 7 Abuja: when will a writ be renewed?
questions.expectContains: for good cause and upon prompt application

questions.question: When do I file Form 17 and 18?
questions.expectContains: Application for Case Management Conference Notice
